newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit weak, but in range as 2.5280 holds.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit weak, but in range as 2.5280 holds.

text.p: The ringgit held at the 2.5280 a dollar support level, after weakening overnight on speculative buying of the U.S. unit, dealers said.
They said the ringgit was stuck in a range and could remain there in the near-term as interest rates in Malaysia firmed.
"The ringgit is basically tracking the dollar/majors. But there is also some local commercial dollar demand," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
He said immediately a generally bullish Malaysian stock market and interest rates, which are expected to rise from Friday, could attract some overseas funds.
A Singapore-based European bank dealer said some of the speculative dollar buying was triggered by expectations of a big Eurodollar syndication in the next few days.
However, dealers said the ringgit would not move from its wide range of 2.52/53 a dollar in the near-term.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5275/82 a dollar against 2.5256/66 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday.
